name: Kinetik
outlook:
What Kinetik says to expect

  • Full year 2026: adjusted EBITDAKinetik now expects its 2026 Adjusted EBITDA 1 to be at the high end of its $1.04 billion to $1.1 billion guidance range, reflecting (i) gas gathering and processing fee benefiting from stronger-than-expected well results; (ii) robust operating performance that has yielded stronger-than-expected equity volumes; and (iii) commodity prices outperforming the Company’s guidance assumptions set forth in August 2026.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresKinetik anticipates 2026 Capital Expenditures 2 (including maintenance) to be approximately 5% below its August 2026 guidance of $560 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
